annotations.title: Redeem $OWL points for a PRO Pass

description: The PRO Pass tiers that $OWL points can be redeemed for, from 7 to 30 days, and whether redemption is open. Points are earned in the Owl Arena and the Pattern Trainer. They have no cash value and cannot be sent, sold or swapped. Redeeming is done by the account holder on the dashboard.
name: redeem_owl_points
